highlights.label: SGD 末迭代的几乎必然速率边界
highlights.text: 在相应二阶矩预言机假设下，给出 SGD 单次无限运行路径上 $k^{-1/3}$ 与 $k^{-1/4}$ 的近匹配上下界。光滑情形的指数取决于是否存在驻点型最小解；步长下界限于文中规定的策略。

highlights.label: 非单调近端法补齐子问题存在性
highlights.text: 分别用四套拓扑条件保证星单调算子的近端子问题有解，再说明单零点与全零点星单调为何有不同收敛后果。多值选择、可和误差及强星单调线性率均需相应条件。

highlights.label: 以非线性 Jensen 映射构造 SOS 证书
highlights.text: 将矩方法的解提取推广到一类非凸多项式，为全称约束构造上下界 SDP 层级。共同 Jensen 结构允许使用更小的乘子；收敛与有限提取仍依赖相应正则和秩条件。

highlights.label: 一般范数下摆脱距离单调性
highlights.text: 用比较点递推和可观测证书分析局部线性更新，允许无界域及下确界不取到。水平集或 PL 条件可进一步改善速率，复杂度还计入失败的半径测试。

highlights.label: 梯度历史平均抵消 Newton sketch 的统计代价
highlights.text: 不增加内层 sketch 次数，用梯度移动平均降低末迭代的极限协方差，再作迭代平均可恢复精确 Newton 的最优协方差。证明处理历史梯度偏差与双时间尺度，需强凸、矩和步长等条件。

highlights.label: 局部联邦更新的偏差—条件数精确边界
highlights.text: 将 Hessian 不交换时的最坏固定点偏差精确化为标量曲率问题，给出指定代理条件数下可达到的边界和少量客户端构成的证书。结论限于共享正谱滤波类，比较的是偏差与条件数。

highlights.label: 几何枚举精确求解每步安全干预
highlights.text: 把平面多边形的超平面与控制联合非凸问题化为多项式数量的候选检查，可行时得到单步全局最优解。在障碍物步内匀速等条件下，显式采样周期保证零阶保持控制的采样间安全。

papers.title: Nearly Tight Almost Sure Convergence Rates for the Last iterate of SGD
papers.abstract: We study the almost sure convergence of the last-iterate optimization error of Stochastic (sub)Gradient Descent (SGD) for convex objectives. For smooth objectives, we establish convergence rates of order $k^{-1/3}$ when a stationary minimizer exists, and $k^{-1/4}$ otherwise, up to polylogarithmic factors, where $k$ denotes the iteration counter. We further show that the latter rate extends to nonsmooth convex objectives. All these rates are achieved by deterministic, anytime stepsize policies. Finally, we establish matching lower bounds showing that the exponents $-1/3$ and $-1/4$ are optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors, for the corresponding problem classes.
papers.summary: SGD 期望误差的收敛率，未必能控制单次无限运行中的末迭代。该文研究凸目标和闭凸可行集，在无偏随机一阶预言机及相应条件二阶矩增长假设下，给出几乎必然末迭代误差的上界，以及多项式指数匹配的下界。对光滑目标，若可行集中存在驻点型最小解，无需预知终止时刻的确定性步长可达到 $k^{-1/3}$ 乘多对数因子的速率；缺少这一条件时，最坏指数降为 $-1/4$。非光滑凸情形也达到后一指数。证明上界时，作者用时变 Moreau 包络与归一化超鞅处理约束和非光滑性；下界构造则结合平坦方向与稀有噪声冲击。这些下界适用于文中规定的可预测标量步长策略。几乎必然速率中的常数和起始时刻可以随运行路径变化。
papers.reason: 这篇适合与期望收敛分析对照阅读：在相同的光滑性和二阶矩信息下，约束最小解是否为驻点，就会改变末迭代的最坏速率指数。上下界把最优点的几何性质与长期噪声波动各自的作用呈现出来，可据此比较末迭代、平均迭代及路径保证。若正在研究难以直接构造目标值超鞅的随机方法，也可以留意时变包络这一步。

papers.title: Beyond Monotone Operators: Zarantonello-type Surjectivity Theorems and the Proximal Point Algorithm
papers.abstract: Outside the maximally monotone class, proximal point iterates need not exist, and their existence is usually assumed. We study the existence and convergence of inexact proximal iterates for set-valued star-monotone operators $T$ on real Hilbert spaces, with $\langle u,x-x^\ast\rangle\geq0$ for some zero $x^\ast$ and every $(x,u)$ in the graph of $T$. This class strictly contains monotone and pseudomonotone operators with zeros. We prove that $\mathrm{Id}+cT$ is surjective for every $c>0$ under four pairwise incomparable topological frameworks, several of whose hypotheses are necessary. Surjectivity can fail under the weak Minty condition with positive violation. For star $\gamma$-hypomonotone operators, $0<c<1/\gamma$ is the sharp range for guaranteed surjectivity. When $T$ is star-monotone at every zero, we give conditions for weak convergence of inexact sequences with summable errors, allowing arbitrary selections from the possibly set-valued resolvent. A counterexample exhibits nonconvergence under star monotonicity at a single zero. Under strong star monotonicity, we obtain strong convergence, including for certain nonsummable errors, and derive explicit R-linear rates. For a class of nonsmooth nonconvex--nonconcave minimax problems with star quasiconvex partial functions, every proximal step exists for every $c>0$. In the strongly star quasiconvex case, we obtain R-linear convergence results with subproblems solved to Clarke stationarity.
papers.summary: 非单调算子的近端点法，首先要解决每个隐式子问题是否有解。该文研究实 Hilbert 空间上的集合值星单调算子，分别在涉及半连续性、图闭性与紧性的四套拓扑条件下，证明 $\mathrm{Id}+cT$ 对所有 $c>0$ 满射；推广到星弱单调算子时，还给出保证满射的步长区间及其尖锐边界。迭代收敛则需要进一步区分：算子是在一个零点处星单调，还是在所有零点处都星单调。在后一性质、相应闭性条件及近端参数具有正下界时，带可和误差的不精确近端序列弱收敛，即使每步从多值预解算子中任意选取也成立。仅在单个零点处星单调则可能不收敛，作者给出了反例。强星单调还能保证强收敛与显式线性率。这些结果也用于满足星拟凸条件的非光滑、非凸非凹极小极大问题。
papers.reason: 子问题有解，并不意味着沿任意选择得到的近端序列都会收敛。本文依次证明子问题存在性、预解算子的径向性质和迭代收敛，适合用来检查将单调算子理论推广到非单调情形时，哪些推理仍然成立。单零点星单调的反例尤其值得读：它指出了只检查某个解附近的几何性质还缺少什么。

papers.title: Theorems of the Alternative and Nonnegativity Certificates for Systems of Jensen-type Polynomials with Universal Quantifiers
papers.abstract: We introduce Jensen-type polynomials, a class of possibly nonconvex polynomials that extends the Jensen inequality for SOS-convex polynomials while retaining natural sums of squares (SOS) certificates for nonnegativity. We show that polynomials with essentially nonpositive coefficients belong to this class and establish a composition principle that yields further examples, including componentwise univariate compositions and compositions with structured quadratic maps motivated by source-localization loss functions. We then derive theorems of the alternative that provide SOS certificates for infeasibility of systems of strict inequalities involving Jensen-type polynomials and universally quantified variables. We illustrate our results through two applications, with numerical examples. First, we show that source-localization problems admit an exact SOS reformulation under a simple dimension condition, and that an optimal solution can be recovered by solving a semidefinite program (SDP) and applying the explicit Jensen map. Second, our SOS certificates yield two {\it convergent} SDP hierarchies for semi-infinite optimization with Jensen-type polynomials, providing upper and lower bounds on the optimal value. We also establish finite-convergence and solution-extraction results, under flat truncation rank condition and the associated Jensen maps.
papers.summary: 矩与平方和松弛常借助 SOS 凸性对应的 Jensen 不等式，从矩信息中直接提取最优点。该文将这一步改为依赖高阶矩的非线性 Jensen 映射，据此定义更广的多项式类，包含具有本质非正系数的非凸多项式，并给出保持这一结构的复合规则。对于含全称量词的不等式系统，作者在共同 Jensen 结构、紧不确定集及相应正则条件下建立择一定理和非负证书，再构造半无限多项式优化的上下界 SDP 层级。收敛、有限终止与解提取分别依赖文中规定的 Slater、Archimedean 或平坦秩条件。下界层级只对有限约束使用非负标量乘子，SOS 乘子也只依赖不确定变量，从而减小松弛规模。源定位例子还在相应维数条件下实现精确重构。
papers.reason: 可以重点看非线性 Jensen 映射如何替代第一矩取点，以及同一个结构如何用于构造证书、上下界和提取解。降低松弛规模的依据来自多项式的共同结构，因此读这篇时，值得将准入条件与各层级的收敛条件逐一对应；这比直接扩大通用 SOS 乘子更能说明哪些非凸半无限问题可以简化。

papers.title: Broximal Gradient Descent in General Norms: Convergence without Fejér Monotonicity
papers.abstract: We study Broximal Gradient Descent in a general norm for smooth optimization over a closed convex set. Each update minimizes the linear model over the intersection of the feasible set and a norm ball. Unlike the Euclidean case with suitably restricted radii, the distance to a solution can increase, even when the squared norm is strongly convex. We instead use a comparator inequality and an observable stationarity certificate. For convex objectives, prescribed radii yield value convergence, including escape when the infimum is unattained, and a last-iterate $O(K^{-1/3})$ bound without a distance-bound assumption. A level-set distance bound gives an all-iteration $O(1/K)$ rate with calibrated radii and an asymptotic $O(\log K/K)$ rate with radii using no problem constant. Strong convexity and power growth give explicit faster envelopes and convergence of the iterates. Without convexity, a constrained Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequality gives linear convergence with prescribed radii. An observable radius-halving rule needs a valid smoothness constant but neither the PL modulus nor an initial gap bound; warm starting gives logarithmic total oracle complexity in inverse accuracy. The analysis separates established local-oracle ingredients from the control of level sets, radius calibration, and accuracy-based oracle counts.
papers.summary: Broximal 梯度法每步在当前点附近的范数球与闭凸可行集的交集中最小化线性模型。一般范数下，这一步却可能把迭代点推得离解更远，即使范数平方强凸也不能避免。该文给出反例后，用比较点不等式和可观测驻点证书重新建立收敛分析。对光滑凸目标，不要求全局有界域，甚至允许下确界不取到；存在最小解时，得到固定终点的末迭代 $O(K^{-1/3})$ 界。若还有水平集距离界，校准半径可达到逐迭代 $O(1/K)$ 率；不使用问题常数的半径选择则带有渐近对数损失。对满足约束 PL 条件的非凸目标，作者分析线性收敛与半径减半规则，并用温启动将精度相关的总局部预言机调用数控制在对数量级。这一自适应保证依赖有效光滑常数，也要求每个局部线性子问题可计算。
papers.reason: 距离不再单调下降后，如何继续证明收敛，是这篇的主要阅读价值。比较点递推说明了一般几何下局部线性更新仍然有效的原因。复杂度分析还把失败的半径测试计入总调用数，便于判断半径标定、水平集控制和自适应规则分别付出了多少代价。

papers.title: A Free Lunch: Gradient Averaging Achieves Optimal Statistical Efficiency in Newton Sketch
papers.abstract: We study statistical inference for online sketched Newton methods, in which each Newton system is approximately solved by an inner randomized sketching solver. Existing work reveals a computational--statistical trade-off: the sketching solver (and its accelerated variants) reduces the per-step cost of Newton methods from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$, but the randomness introduced by sketching also inflates the limiting covariance of both the last and the averaged Newton iterates. In this work, we address this trade-off via gradient averaging. We show that simply replacing the stochastic gradient with a moving average at each step can mitigate, and in some cases eliminate, the trade-off in Newton sketch. Importantly, gradient averaging requires no additional oracle evaluations and leaves the contraction bound of the inner sketching solver unchanged. In particular, we prove that the last sketched Newton iterate with gradient averaging attains a limiting covariance no larger than that without gradient averaging, while the averaged iterate even attains the minimax optimal limiting covariance, matching that of the exact Newton method. To our knowledge, this is the first analysis showing that randomness introduced to improve computational efficiency need not compromise statistical efficiency as long as proper gradient estimates are used. The key analytical challenge is that gradient averaging destroys the crucial martingale difference structure underlying central limit theorem arguments. We overcome this challenge by analyzing the coupled two-timescale recursions governing the iterate and the gradient estimator. Numerical experiments on linear and logistic regression support our theoretical covariance comparisons.
papers.summary: 在线 Newton 法每步只做固定次数的随机 sketch，可以降低线性求解成本，却可能放大极限协方差。该文保持内层求解器和 sketch 次数不变，将当前随机梯度换成历史梯度的移动平均。作者耦合优化误差与梯度跟踪误差，通过双时间尺度递推证明几乎必然收敛。在总体强凸光滑、Hessian 正则、矩增长及 sketch 非退化等条件下，还建立了渐近正态性：移动平均后的末迭代极限协方差不大于单样本梯度版本；再作 Polyak–Ruppert 迭代平均，可以恢复精确在线 Newton 法的最优极限协方差。每步新增的工作仅为一次向量平均，无需额外梯度、Hessian 或 sketch 查询。渐近正态性另需高于二阶的梯度矩和相应步长条件。
papers.reason: 历史梯度是在不同位置计算的，复用它们会破坏通常的条件无偏性。本文用双时间尺度分析与分部求和恢复主导噪声表示，这部分直接对应随机算法中信息复用和误差跟踪的困难。对于希望减少近似 Newton 求解的统计损失的研究者，建议重点读末迭代协方差的比较，以及为何还需迭代平均才能恢复最优协方差。

papers.title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
papers.abstract: Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[\mu,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $\chi\in[1,L/\mu]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.
papers.summary: 联邦方法增加局部计算后，聚合更新的条件数可能改善，固定点却也可能偏离全局最小解。该文研究 Hessian 谱位于 $[\mu,L]$ 的强凸二次客户端，用共享正谱滤波器表示局部更新，并以全局最优点处客户端梯度的均方根衡量异质性。给定统一代理条件数上界 $\chi$，作者求得单位异质性下最小可达的最坏固定点偏差 $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$，其中 $1\leq\chi\leq L/\mu$。证明将任意维、Hessian 可以不交换的客户端群体精确化为标量曲率分布，并构造至多三个标量客户端组成的证书。适当的局部梯度步和近端更新均可达到边界。近端偏差分析还推广到一般光滑强凸目标，允许不精确局部求解。这个边界比较的是偏差与条件数，适用对象是没有额外持久纠偏状态的上述谱滤波类。
papers.reason: 精确标量化与最坏实例证书值得细读：任意维度中的局部漂移，最终可以用少量标量客户端刻画，并得到可达到的代价边界。它为分布式算法比较提出一个具体检查点——对代理问题收敛更快时，原目标的解偏了多少。也可据此分析，加入持久纠偏状态究竟改变了哪一类算法及其边界。

papers.title: Control-Aware Separating Hyperplanes for Control Barrier Functions in Planar Navigation
papers.abstract: Separating hyperplanes are widely used in Control Barrier Function (CBF)-based collision avoidance, yet their orientations strongly govern control intervention-the deviation of the applied control from the robot's nominal command. Existing methods typically select hyperplane orientations from geometry alone. Jointly optimizing orientations and control yields a continuous, non-convex problem in which local nonlinear solvers suffer from initialization sensitivity, local minima, and unpredictable latency, while discretized orientation grids scale exponentially with obstacle count. For planar navigation of a polygonal robot among polygonal obstacles, we present a solver-free, control-aware separating hyperplane selection method that directly computes a global optimum of this joint problem at each step whenever it is feasible. Exploiting the geometry of Minkowski difference polygons, we reduce this continuous non-convex optimization to evaluating a polynomial-size set of candidate control interventions via closed-form algebraic checks, selecting the feasible candidate of minimum norm. Across 250 simulated navigation scenarios, our method reduces cumulative intervention cost by 3.6% at the median and 27.3% at the 90th percentile compared to a local nonlinear solver, and completion time by 0.6% and 5.6%, respectively. In scalability benchmarks, it achieves a 6.1x per-step speedup at 16 simultaneous obstacles.
papers.summary: 多边形避障若同时优化分离超平面与控制输入，每步就要解一个连续非凸问题，局部求解的质量和时延可能不稳定。该文针对平面双积分机器人及仅作平移的多边形足迹与障碍物，利用 Minkowski 差多边形，把最小控制干预问题化为多项式数量的代数候选。候选包括边界投影和交点；检查可行性后，从中选择范数最小者。在联合问题可行、名义输入满足执行器界时，所选控制就是该步的全局最优解。作者还给出固定超平面、零阶保持控制下的显式采样周期界：若障碍物在该步匀速运动，且初始高阶屏障条件成立，安全保证便覆盖整个采样间隔。250 个仿真场景及规模实验展示了干预代价和求解速度上的收益。
papers.reason: 这篇的优化贡献集中在精确求解：二维几何将连续非凸问题缩减为多项式数量的候选检查，同时保留单步全局最优保证。对需要安全约束的算法，建议连同采样周期界一起读，检查求解质量、确定性运行成本和采样间可行性如何共同成立。

papers.title: Quadratically Regularized Medians in Metric and Wasserstein Spaces
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new class of robust aggregators in Wasserstein spaces. After proving that all the commonly used Wasserstein barycenters are manipulable by one single corrupted input through a novel first-order optimality condition, we generalize both to the metric setting and to fractional exponents the concept of Lipschitz resilience introduced recently by Allouah, Guerraoui, Hoang and Villemaud. We proceed to show that adding a quadratic regularization to Wasserstein medians defined either in terms of the $W_1$-metric or linearized $W_2$-metric are resilient in that sense, by leveraging fine convexity estimates along generalized geodesics and flat interpolations. We finally show that iteratively solving the latter problem amounts to performing a Majorization-Minimization approximation of $W_2$-medians.
papers.summary: Wasserstein 均值型聚合可能被一个受污染输入推向任意远的位置，而经典崩溃点不能量化有限攻击的影响。该文将 Lipschitz 韧性推广到一般度量和 Hölder 指数，用均匀凸性给出影响上界的判据，并构造以锚点为中心的二次正则中位数。有界密度锚点等条件下，正则 $W_1$ 中位数具有 Hölder 韧性；在线性化 $W_2$ 几何中，绝对连续锚点允许用运输映射作 Hilbert 表示，从而得到 Lipschitz 韧性与密度控制。作者还将反复求解线性化正则中位数写成普通 $W_2$ 中位数的 MM 近似，并在相应条件下证明聚点为临界点。锚定正则会改变聚合器的代表性性质，韧性界也随被修改输入的权重变化。
papers.reason: 污染影响的上界可以从优化目标的增长条件推导，这为设计可计算的鲁棒聚合器提供了具体依据。值得比较的是，不同 Wasserstein 几何为何分别得到 Hölder 和 Lipschitz 保证，以及线性化表示怎样产生 MM 更新。

papers.title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
papers.abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a fundamental and ubiquitous technique for dimension reduction and representation learning, yet its empirical formulation remains vulnerable to distributional uncertainty. While distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offers a natural remedy, existing order-2 Wasserstein models of PCA either preserve the nominal PCA subspace or lack an exact reformulation. This paper demonstrates how the infinity-Wasserstein distance can reconcile these two desirable properties. For the resulting DRO model of PCA, we derive an exact finite-dimensional reformulation and explicitly identify a worst-case distribution attaining the inner maximum. Crucially, the reformulated objective retains samplewise residual information beyond the empirical covariance matrix, revealing a mechanism through which distributional robustness can reshape the learned principal subspace. Under the mild assumption that the true distribution has a finite fourth moment, we further establish a uniform finite-sample performance guarantee for the proposed model. An iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization algorithm is also developed to solve the resulting nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization problem, with a rigorous analysis of its convergence properties. Numerical experiments substantiate the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithm and the practical effectiveness of the infinity-Wasserstein model in downstream applications.
papers.summary: 某些二阶 Wasserstein 鲁棒 PCA 可以精确重写，最优子空间却仍与普通 PCA 一样。该文改用无穷阶 Wasserstein 球，得到有限维精确重写，并能显式构造最坏分布。新目标含有逐样本残差范数，利用了经验协方差之外的信息，因此可以改变最优子空间。在有限四阶矩及相应矩参数条件下，作者建立了对所有候选子空间和中心同时成立的高概率样本外上界。所得问题非凸且非光滑，论文采用带保护的重加权 MM，每步通过加权均值和加权 PCA 计算，并证明目标下降、聚点驻性等收敛性质。模型半径与有限样本条件决定统计鲁棒性的保证，算法的驻点结果则说明求解到了什么程度。
papers.reason: 鲁棒集合如何改变最优解，是读这篇的一个切入点；另一个是精确重写后，逐样本残差结构如何用于构造 MM 更新。模型选择、对所有子空间同时成立的统计上界和实际求解步骤都有对应结果，便于分别检查建模与算法的收益。

papers.title: A Euclidean Quasi-Newton Method for Matrix-Manifold Optimization via Almost-Global Coordinates
papers.abstract: We study smooth matrix-manifold optimization using objective values and first derivatives. Almost-global coordinates transform the manifold-constrained problem into an unconstrained pullback problem, to which we apply BFGS with a chart-restart strategy and a limited-memory implementation. We establish correspondence of first- and second-order stationary points and minimizers, together with conditional convergence and local q-superlinear convergence. The local rate follows from Euclidean full-memory BFGS theory once the chart is fixed, without the locking condition required by classical transported-gradient Riemannian BFGS analyses. Tests on 15 benchmark problems from Manopt and Pymanopt, with ten instances per problem, show that our limited-memory method solves all 150 cases, whereas Riemannian BFGS and Riemannian steepest descent solve 132 and 117 cases, respectively. On the 115 cases successfully solved by all three methods, our method takes roughly half the time of either baseline, measured by geometric-mean solve time.
papers.summary: 流形 BFGS 通常要在不同切空间之间运输历史割线信息，运输与回缩的兼容性增加了实现和局部分析的困难。该文用矩阵流形的几乎全局坐标将约束目标拉回欧氏空间，在固定图内积累标准 BFGS 割线对，并在半径条件触发时重新定心、重启坐标图。作者证明图像范围内的一、二阶驻点和极小点的对应关系，并给出图重启最终停止的条件。在固定图及通常的局部正定性、光滑性和线搜索假设下，全记忆 BFGS 达到局部 q 超线性率。数值实现采用有限记忆方法，在 150 个测试实例上优于所选黎曼基线。这里的局部速率定理适用于全记忆方法，实验检验的是有限记忆实现；使用历史信息还需承担坐标映射与重启的成本。
papers.reason: 坐标图发生变化后，需要重新考虑历史曲率对是否仍有一致含义。本文通过固定图积累割线对、必要时重启来处理这个问题，适合研究几何变化中的历史信息保存与失效处理。阅读时可以重点看图重启何时停止，以及停止后如何接上欧氏 BFGS 的局部理论；同时留意全记忆定理与有限记忆实现之间的区别。

papers.title: Taming the Tails of Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Interpolation Regime
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study stochastic gradient descent in the smooth interpolation regime, where the population objective shares a common minimizer with the sample losses. In contrast to prior work, which has largely focused on in-expectation analysis, we obtain high-probability convergence guarantees under the same assumptions. In the convex case, we prove a fast rate of order $\log(\beta^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$ after $n$ iterations, with failure probability at most $\beta$. In the strongly convex case, we derive a family of moment-based bounds of order $\beta^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$ for $p \in (0,1]$, and complement them with a matching lower bound showing that the corresponding deterioration in the exponential rate is essentially unavoidable. In both settings, our theoretical results are unified across a broad class of step-size schedules. Building on this analysis, we extend our results to a low-noise regime and to nonconvex objectives satisfying the Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition.
papers.summary: 插值情形下，每个样本损失都光滑，且与总体目标共享最小解，SGD 的期望收敛可以很快，但这还不能直接给出单次运行的尾概率。该文借助相应步长规则的 Fejér 单调性控制迭代位置，在凸情形得到阶为 $\log(\beta^{-1})/n$ 的高概率界，覆盖固定步长及文中规定的随机线搜索和 Polyak 类步长规则。强凸情形中，置信度与指数收敛率之间存在由矩参数调节的权衡；采样梯度长时间为零的下界例子说明，相应速率损失基本不可避免。作者还分析了最优点噪声次高斯时的低噪声扩展，以及非凸 PL 目标的指数尾界。各项结论分别要求相应的样本光滑性、插值或噪声条件。
papers.reason: 可以与同日的几乎必然末迭代速率论文对照：这篇回答有限时刻达到给定置信度要付出多少代价，所用的结构也不同。Fejér 单调性如何将轨迹控制转为尾概率界，以及停滞事件为何阻止强凸情形直接继承确定性指数率，是两处具体可借鉴的分析。

papers.title: Inversion of Set-Valued Wiener Models
papers.abstract: A Wiener system consists of a linear system followed by a nonlinear system. This paper addresses the problem of recovering a vector in a Hilbert space from the outputs of multiple Wiener systems. While prior literature on provably convergent methods has studied this problem under the assumption that the nonlinear operators are single-valued and firmly nonexpansive, we investigate the broader setting in which the nonlinear operators are set-valued and maximally cohypomonotone. We design a splitting algorithm for this extended framework and establish its convergence. Our framework remains novel even in the special case of maximally monotone operators. Numerical applications to signal and image recovery are presented.
papers.summary: Wiener 观测先经过线性系统，再由非线性传感器输出。已有可证明恢复方法常要求传感器为单值牢固非扩张映射。该文将观测写成 $r_k\in A_k(L_kx)$，允许集合值、最大余弱单调非线性，并通过平移预解算子和乘积空间重写构造分裂迭代。在全局余弱单调、观测相容及相应算子参数条件下，序列弱收敛到满足全部观测关系的解。非线性只具备局部性质时，作者另给出需要局部化条件的算法与局部收敛分析。即使仅考虑最大单调传感器，这个框架也能表示此前单值方法无法直接处理的量化、死区等集合值模型。音频和图像例子展示了恢复算法的用法。
papers.reason: 这里可借鉴的是分裂方法的构造：直接保留传感器的集合值图，再把余弱单调关系改写为可处理的固定点问题。它提供了处理不连续观测的一种算法建模方式；全局与局部收敛所需结构的差别，也便于判断方法能推广到哪里。

papers.title: From Consensus-Based Optimization to Evolution Strategies: Proof of Global Convergence
papers.abstract: Consensus-based optimization (CBO) is a powerful and versatile zero-order multi-particle method designed to provably solve high-dimensional global optimization problems, including those that are genuinely nonconvex or nonsmooth. The method relies on a balance between stochastic exploration and contraction toward a consensus point, which is defined via the Laplace principle as a proxy for the global minimizer. In this paper, we introduce new CBO variants that address practical and theoretical limitations of the original formulation of this novel optimization methodology. First, we propose a model called $\delta$-CBO}, which incorporates nonvanishing diffusion to prevent premature collapse to suboptimal states. We also develop a numerically stable implementation, the Consensus Freezing scheme, that remains robust even for arbitrarily large time steps by freezing the consensus point over time intervals. We connect these models through appropriate asymptotic limits. Furthermore, we derive from the Consensus Freezing scheme by suitable time rescaling and asymptotics a further algorithm, the Consensus Hopping scheme, which can be interpreted as a form of $(1,\lambda)$-Evolution Strategy. For all these schemes, we characterize for the first time the invariant measures and establish global convergence results, including exponential convergence rates.
papers.summary: 经典共识型全局优化的探索噪声会随粒子收缩而消失，有限粒子可能过早塌缩，常用时间离散也有稳定性限制。该文用非消失扩散构造 $\delta$-CBO，再提出 Consensus Freezing：在每个时间区间内冻结共识点，使该段 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 演化可以精确采样。作者分析不变分布、指数趋近与极限关系，并通过时间缩放联系到可视为进化策略的 Consensus Hopping。在唯一全局极小点及相应增长、正则假设下，逆温参数足够大时，不变高斯的中心接近全局极小点。有限粒子分析分别估计传播混沌误差、有限样本误差、暂态和逆温偏差。固定扩散意味着分布仍有宽度；理论常数和所需参数也随问题及维数变化。
papers.reason: 冻结共识点使每段动力学可以精确采样，这是连接连续模型与稳定离散的一处具体设计。建议分别看不变分布的收敛、分布中心与全局极小点的距离，以及有限粒子的误差，弄清这类进化式随机搜索的全局保证各自控制什么。

papers.title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
papers.abstract: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matching, tuned baselines and paired seeds. Orthogonalizing Q, K and V separately rather than as one fused matrix lowers the loss by 0.0250 nats and accounts for all of the gain of block-wise variants. A matmul-only, rotation-equivariant spectral tilt $\sigma^{-1/4}$ applied in the cooldown lowers the loss of this stronger baseline by a further 0.0120 nats, additively with NorMuon (0.0158 nats together, three seeds; the baseline needs about 4.3% more tokens to match), and by 0.0188 nats at 355M parameters (three seeds). Energy-matched Schatten-1 weight decay adds a further 0.0052 nats. Geometrically principled changes that do not act on the measured miscalibration, namely exact polar factors, steepest-descent input whitening and top-heavy decay, do not help.
papers.summary: Muon 沿动量矩阵的极分解方向更新，各奇异方向步长相同，却未按损失曲率分配。该文用独立留出梯度与 Hessian 向量积测量方向组之间的联合二阶结构，将误差分成总体尺度与相对形状两部分，并给出保持更新范数时、重新分配步长可改善局部模型的判据。在所测语言模型中，顶部奇异方向在训练中段和降温初期相对过步。将融合 QKV 分开正交化，以及向尾部倾斜的谱滤波，在匹配更新范数、调优基线和配对种子的比较中改善了损失。作者也报告了改进失效的训练阶段，以及没有收益的几何干预。理论判据基于局部二阶模型，实验限于 124M、355M 模型及所用数据和训练预算。
papers.reason: 分析使用动量历史的优化器时，可以借鉴本文将更新方向与实际损失曲率对照的诊断方法。匹配更新范数后，再区分总体尺度和方向分配，并控制 QKV 融合的实现因素，能帮助判断收益究竟来自哪一步。报告无收益的干预和失效阶段，也让这种机理解释更容易检验。
